correctness.rationale: The four disjoint factor classes have exact constructive parametrizations. The two-one factor constraints a<=j-1 and b<=j+1 and the three-one rising-gap obstruction are proven from adjacent complete zero runs. Counting mutually present nonpalindromic reversals gives H(z)=z^2/((1-z)(1-z^2))+z^5/((1-z)(1-z^2)(1-z^3)); factor enumeration gives P(z)=1+z(2-z-z^2+z^3)/((1-z)^3(1+z)). Exact subtraction produces the stated R(z) and period-six coefficients for all n>=0. An actual standalone verifier additionally passed 124 independent finite language checks, without treating finite checks as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2024 introduction of reflection complexity motivates evaluating it for nonrecurrent, non-reversal-closed words. The triangular-number indicator is a natural sparse word with full quadratic factor complexity. The new exact reversal-pair classification produces a genuinely sharp period-six law and asymptotic ratio 2/3, separating it from both reversal-closed and no-pair regimes; it is a complete nontrivial natural invariant, not a table of arbitrary small parameters.
